glossary.definition: (1) "Drug abuse offense" has the same meaning as in section 2925.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3319.20 - Notification of nonlicensed employee's guilty plea or conviction of certain offenses.

glossary.definition: (2) "Intervention in lieu of conviction" means intervention in lieu of conviction under section 2951.041 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3319.20 - Notification of nonlicensed employee's guilty plea or conviction of certain offenses.

glossary.definition: (3) "Pre-trial diversion program" means a pre-trial diversion program under section 2935.36 of the Revised Code or a similar diversion program under rules of a court.
glossary.source_title: Section 3319.20 - Notification of nonlicensed employee's guilty plea or conviction of certain offenses.

glossary.definition: (4) "Prosecutor" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 3319.20 - Notification of nonlicensed employee's guilty plea or conviction of certain offenses.

glossary.definition:
(5) "Theft offense" has the same meaning as in section 2913.01 of the Revised Code.
